i thought this would be greasier/oilier than what it is. make sure you shake the bottle. i apply this before my day cream and my face is moisturized for the day but NOT greasy.

reviews.t: Looking Like A Holy Grail Skincare Product
reviews.x: Wow! I love this serum! It works perfectly over my PTR Turbo serum (I was concerned I would have to alternate products) and before my night and day creams. It does not break me out, as a matter of fact it seems my skin is clearer if anything! Highly recommend this for anyone with dry skin. It does have some fragrance, it smells very lightly of oranges...but it is not overwhelming. An affordable product that delivers on it's promises, how's that for a refreshing change :)

Love this sutff!  I call it my aging nectar!  I wear it every day...not sticky or greasy like some and I love the compliments on my "glow"!  I have used department store products like Lancome and Clinique that have the same results as this product...at 6-8 times the price.  I highly recommend for anyone with dry skin but especially for my over 40 people (like me) who are beginning to show the faint (or not so faint) signs of aging...moisture is key!

I am just using it for 2 days and I love it . My lines under my eyes are almost gone . I have been trying so many products for years and this is the first one that is working . My only complain is the bottle top .It is unscrewing and opening every time I am touching  the top to use it and there are spills no matter how careful I am . Maybe I got a defected one or there is  a need to change  this bottle closing.

This product is amazing, for some reason when i seen it while browsing for some type of face moisturizer ( my skin around my t zone gets dry around the winter) i knew it would be a good buy and the price was not bad at all. so i got and i absolutely love it. i gave it five stars cause it deserves it. i would highly recommend  to anyone needing a little tlc for their skin :)

Well, being a Finlander myself, I can only say that these Finlanders really know skin care!  I will be ordering more of this stuff definitely!! It does what it says it does!! Great for fine lines around your eyes!!!

reviews.t: Very glad I discovered this skin saver

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for moisturizing dry skin and leaving it dewy and fresh.
Many reviewers say it is not greasy and absorbs quickly, though some note it can be too oily for combination skin if misused.
Reviewers repeatedly highlight its affordability compared to expensive department store brands with similar results.
Several reviewers report improvements to fine lines, especially around the eyes.
A few reviewers mention the bottle top is a complaint, unscrewing or opening when touched.
